about.title: About Kendle learnAI
about.lead: We help people understand and master artificial intelligence through clear, honest, practical content.
about.mission: AI is changing how we learn, work and create. Yet most of the best material is dense with jargon and far from everyday practice. Kendle learnAI exists to close that gap: every article explains the core idea, shows how to apply it, and is honest about the technology's limits.

values.title: Honesty
values.text: No hype. We say what AI can and cannot do.

values.title: Practicality
values.text: We prioritise what you can apply to your work this week.

values.title: Community
values.text: We listen to readers and write for real needs.

audience: Managers who need to understand AI to decide well
